about: packages/pass/src/props.json: the pass story's part of the catalogue of 3D sets (props; docs/props.md, tools/packages/SPEC.md "Miniatures"): what the design room's card of each of its miniatures shows; code is authoritative

sets.shows: A school of 300 fish (30 to 600, a live simulation) all around you, each watching its seven nearest neighbours; water, seabed with caustics, rocks, seagrass, light shafts; a shark you steer or that comes now and then; the school can be pulled apart by watching fewer neighbours.
sets.frame: Life size: 1 unit = 1 m, eyes at the origin (1.6 m), seabed 6.5 m below, surface 15 m above.

params.name: fish_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: fish_n
params.meaning: how many fish (30-600; new ones join beside a fish already swimming)

params.name: fish_k
params.meaning: neighbours each fish watches (rounded, 1-12)

params.name: fish_links
params.meaning: the network: 0 hidden, 1 shown (fades)

params.name: fish_water
params.meaning: the water and everything in it; below 0.5 (passthrough AR) hidden, the school at a third of life size

params.name: fish_shark
params.meaning: above 0.5 a shark comes now and then (explore)

params.name: fish_hunt
params.meaning: a shark each time this passes a whole number (for the story)

params.name: fish_scale
params.meaning: the whole set's size on top of life size (for the rise to the globe: towards 0 the sea, dome and all, shrinks to a dot at the origin)

views.name: default
views.frames: among the fish, life size, looking up a little (eyes at 1.6 m)

views.name: near
views.frames: from just outside the school: each fish and its links apart

views.name: above
views.frames: high above, looking down on the school

data.text: A live simulation adapted from the flock's; nothing is data.

sets.notes: update depends on what came before, so seeking changes only the params. Step params fish_n, fish_k, fish_hunt. In passthrough the school shrinks to a third of life size. Exports see, steer, hold, scatter, shark, falcon, kept, setLang, state, watch ...

sets.shows: The airports story's globe exactly as it is (3,214 airports, 18,858 routes), driven from params, with a seeded S/E/I/R outbreak on its real routes: pick a start airport, set incubation, infectious days, spread and flights cut, and play the days.
sets.frame: Radius 1, centred on the origin, y up, longitude 0 towards +x, 90 E towards -z.

params.name: globe_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: globe_reveal
params.meaning: the airports and routes appear (the original's node_reveal and route_reveal)

params.name: globe_routes
params.meaning: brightness of the routes (the original's route_alpha)

params.name: globe_hubs
params.meaning: airports coloured by their number of routes (the original's w_deg)

params.name: globe_pillars
params.meaning: pillars by number of routes (the original's deg_h)

params.name: globe_dim
params.meaning: dims the plain airports and routes, so the outbreak's colours stand out

params.name: globe_out
params.meaning: the outbreak shown (its cities, arcs, chain and labels)

params.name: globe_day
params.meaning: the outbreak's day (continuous; ease it)

views.name: atlantic
views.frames: the Atlantic with Europe and the Americas

views.name: start
views.frames: turned to the start city by setup

reads: PASS_AIRPORTS (cut out of packages/airports/main.js at build)
data.text: OpenFlights airports and routes; the outbreak is a simple model, not a forecast.

sets.notes: Cut unchanged out of packages/airports/main.js by packages/pass/src/build.mjs: rebuild the pass story after changing it. Same start and settings give the same outbreak on every device. globe_day is a step (continuous). English and German via setLang. Exports api (setup, start, settings, end, series, count, summary, arrivalDay, chain, select, pick, find, info, search ...).

sets.shows: The cell map story's cell exactly as it is (249 proteins in 13 places, 252 links, 10 organelles, 7 moves): organelles appear one by one, proteins and links by place or colour, the growth signal from EGF to SRF, the TNF to NF-kB relay, and the moves that go wrong (CFTR in the ER, TDP-43 leaving the nucleus).
sets.frame: Radius 1, centred on the origin; a cell about 20 micrometres across, the membrane a slightly flattened ellipsoid.

params.name: cell_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: cell_org
params.meaning: organelles shown: they appear one by one (membrane, nucleus, nucleolus, ER, Golgi, mitochondria, lysosomes, vesicles, peroxisomes, cytoskeleton)

params.name: cell_shell
params.meaning: the organelles' skins (1 on, 0.35 faint, 0 off)

params.name: cell_reveal
params.meaning: proteins and links appear

params.name: cell_links

params.name: cell_ids
params.meaning: the dotted links between the copies of one protein

params.name: cell_multi
params.meaning: colour by number of places instead of by place

params.name: cell_focus
params.meaning: the rest dims, the growth signal's proteins glow as the signal reaches them

params.name: cell_ex
params.meaning: two proteins meet: EGF, its receptor and GRB2 (0-1)

params.name: cell_cue
params.meaning: the relay from TNF to NF-kB's brake (0-1) and its alpha

params.name: cell_cue_a
params.meaning: the relay from TNF to NF-kB's brake (0-1) and its alpha

params.name: cell_path
params.meaning: the growth signal, in hops (0-10), and its alpha

params.name: cell_names

params.name: cell_nfkb

data.text: Curated protein locations and links (complexes, textbook pathways, Human Protein Atlas / UniProt); the layout is illustrative.

sets.notes: Cut unchanged out of packages/spatial/main.js by packages/pass/src/build.mjs. 541 anchors (one per protein copy and organelle). cell_cue and the moves ease at a limited rate (MOVE_P). English and German (roles in ROLE_DE). Exports api (pick, info, select, moveDelta, protein, copyOf, pos, search, moves, move, path, highlight, setFocus, isolate, places, growthPath, relay, counts).
